items.headline: There's sudden urgency for old NFC East rivals as Commanders visit Cowboys following opening losses
items.description: — There's a sudden sense of urgency as the Washington Commanders and Dallas Cowboys renew an old NFC East rivalry with both teams staring at an 0-2 start in division games.

items.headline: Record $595 million bet with New York sportsbooks in NFL Week 1
items.description: Bettors wagered approximately $595 million with New York sportsbooks in Week 1 of the NFL season, the most for an opening week since the state launched online betting in 2022, according to revenue numbers released Thursday.
